faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common customer questions.

original.a: No, AROMA DONNA is a student project. Brands and products are fictional; real orders and payments are not accepted.

choose.q: How do I choose a fragrance online?
choose.a: Look at the fragrance family and notes on the product page, or take the Scent finder quiz — it will show suitable options.

concentration.q: What is the difference between EDT, EDP and Parfum?
concentration.a: It is the concentration of aromatic oils: Eau de Toilette is the lightest, Eau de Parfum lasts longer, and Parfum is the richest and most long-lasting.

delivery.a: Courier in Bishkek — 300 KGS (free from 7,000 KGS), regions — 450 KGS (free from 12,000 KGS), pickup — free.

payment.a: No. No payments are processed on the site: only payment on delivery in cash or by card.

promo.q: How do I apply a promo code?
promo.a: Enter the code in the cart and press Apply. Demo codes: AROMA10, DONNA500, WELCOME15. These are not real promotions.

return.a: The demo terms state that an unopened bottle can be returned within 14 days.

account.a: Your account keeps your order history. Without Firebase, registration works in demo mode and stores data only in your browser.

quiz.q: Does the scent quiz use artificial intelligence?
quiz.a: No. It uses clear rules: points are given for matching family, notes, intensity, category and budget.

storage.q: Will my cart be kept after I close the site?
storage.a: Yes. Cart, favorites, language and theme are saved in your browser's localStorage.
